title_hook: Everyone admires the sail. The storm tests the keel.
concept: The keel - what is below the waterline keeps you upright
quote: Everyone admires the sail. The storm only tests the keel.
core_metaphor: Sailboat in a storm: visible sail versus unseen keel.
primary_prompt: 9:16 vertical cinematic sequence: a lone sailboat in a night storm, the camera descending below the chaotic surface to a deep heavy keel in calm dark water, a larger-sailed boat capsizing while the deep-keeled boat rights itself.

hook.text: Everyone admires the sail. The storm only tests the keel.
hook.visual: 9:16 vertical, night storm at sea: a lone sailboat with a vast bone-white (#F5F2EB) sail lit by lightning, heeling hard in black water (#0A1418). Rain streaks, heavy swell. Camera low at water level, static.

build.text: The part of you nobody sees is the part that keeps you upright. Your habits. Your word. What you do when the cameras are off.
build.visual: Camera descends below the waterline in one continuous move: beneath the chaotic surface the water is calm and dark, and a long heavy keel extends deep, edged in thin gold (#C6A94F) light. Silent contrast between chaos above and stillness below.

pivot.text: When the wind hits sideways, the boat with the bigger sail goes over first. The deeper keel stays.
pivot.visual: Wide split-depth shot: a second boat with a larger sail capsizes in the background as a wave strikes, while the first boat leans and rights itself, its keel pivoting slowly underwater. Dramatic, physical, slow motion.

resolution.text: So build down before you build up. Weight below the waterline. Character before attention. Depth before speed.
resolution.visual: Underwater medium shot: the keel holding steady as currents stream past it, fine crimson (#DC143C) stress lines along its edge but no movement. Gold light filtering down from the surface. Calm, monumental.

mobius_close.text: Because the storm is coming either way. The only question is what you have under...
mobius_close.visual: Camera rises from the deep back toward the surface and the storm, breaking through into rain and the bone-white sail, matching the opening geometry. Unresolved.

caption: The part of you nobody sees is the part that keeps you upright. Build down before you build up.
